name: A Lonely Ride
source:
You wake up on a boat with no recollection of how you  got there. Maybe this mysterious woman can answer a few questions for you?

A short game about death and the process of moving on.

[from [url=https://yuyu-mortis.itch.io/a-lonely-ride]itch.io[/url]]
